title: Google Ads Campaign Architecture & Smart Bidding Engine
overview: Google Ads captures commercial intent across Search, Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube, Display, and Demand Gen networks using machine learning smart bidding.
coreConcepts: Commercial intent query matching (Exact, Phrase, Broad with Smart Bidding)
Quality Score determined by expected CTR, ad relevance, and landing page experience
Performance Max asset group multi-channel inventory aggregation
First-party customer match lists for privacy-safe audience targeting
features: Target ROAS (tROAS) and Target CPA (tCPA) automated bidding algorithms
Enhanced Conversions with SHA-256 hashed customer identifiers
Value-based bidding with custom conversion value adjustment rules
Dynamic Search Ads (DSA) and Responsive Search Ads (RSA) auto-generation
bestPractices: Maintain at least 15 to 30 conversions per month per campaign for stable bidding algorithm learning
Pin maximum 1 headline only when legally required; allow Google ML to rotate combinations
Maintain centralized shared negative keyword lists across brand and non-brand campaigns
Pair Broad Match keywords strictly with Target CPA or Target ROAS to prevent query bleed
policies: Google Ads Misrepresentation and Deceptive Content policies
Mandatory advertiser verification with government entity documentation
Trademark bidding policies and competitor comparison guidelines
limitations: Standard Google Ads API rate limit: 15,000 operations per day on basic access
Learning phase duration of 7 days following any budget change > 20%
PMax search term visibility limited to high-volume aggregate queries
commonIssues: Campaign stuck in 'Learning Limited' status due to low conversion volume
Keyword cannibalization between PMax and Standard Search campaigns
High wasted spend on mobile gaming app display placements

troubleshootingGuide.issue: Performance Max stealing traffic from Standard Search brand campaigns
troubleshootingGuide.resolution: Apply Account-Level Brand Exclusion List or contact Google rep to add negative keywords to PMax campaign

troubleshootingGuide.issue: Bidding algorithm stuck in Learning Limited
troubleshootingGuide.resolution: Switch bid strategy temporarily to Maximize Conversions or step up the funnel to a micro-conversion event
